assessments.reasoning: The raw intervals anchor the two pages of the retained PDF. Page 8 distinguishes state shared among a guardian’s processes from objects private to a process. Page 9 supplies both the inter-guardian call rule and the value-passing rule in the 1983 design.

challenge.method: Check whether sharing covers every local object and whether a handler argument can transmit a reference to the caller’s object.
challenge.results: Local sharing is possible for guardian state. Process-private objects are an explicit limit. The design excludes passing an object reference through a handler call. Later editions are outside this finding.

limitations: The paper supplies the design boundary. This has not been checked against the complete 1987 reference.
